subject: Sentinel Bank MAP: security acceptance criteria & data retention cadence
messages:
From: Natalie Reed <natalie.reed@sentinelbank.com>

Cc: Aaron Mills <aaron.mills@sentinelbank.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Initial MAP items: SOC 2 scope, SIG/CAIQ, DPA & retention

Sofia —

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. We're ready to lock in a mutual action plan so our InfoSec and legal teams can do a parallel review. Key asks from our side to include in the MAP:

- SOC 2 report (Type II) and expected delivery date for next attestation cycle.
- Completed CAIQ (SIG-lite) and answers for data processing controls.
- Draft DPA redlines and confirmation on subprocessor list.
- Data retention windows for logs, user content, and backups; eDiscovery/export procedures.

Can you confirm what role-level evidence you can provide within 10 business days, and which items need a longer runway? Attached is a simple MAP template we use.

Also copying Aaron (security engineer) — he'll own the CAIQ and technical questions.

—Natalie
Natalie Reed
Head of Security & Compliance
Sentinel Bank

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP items: SOC 2 scope, SIG/CAIQ, DPA & retention

Natalie — thanks for the clear list. We're happy to align on a short MAP and suggested timelines. High-level response first-pass: 

- SOC 2: We can provide our latest Type II report (FY2026) as evidence within 3 business days. The next attestation window is Q2 2027; we'll note expected dates in the MAP.
- CAIQ / SIG: Kimberly will own completing the CAIQ answers; we can deliver a completed CAIQ + supporting notes within 8 business days.
- DPA: Ben will coordinate commercial/legal redlines. For standard customers we accept a subset of redlines; turnaround for initial redline response: ~5 business days after we receive their markups.
- Data retention: see initial proposal below (these are negotiable):
  - User content: default 90 days after account termination unless customer requests longer retention.
  - Logs (platform telemetry): 365 days; longer retention via enterprise add-on.
  - KV cache/prefix cache: ephemeral per session; not stored beyond 30 days for debugging snapshots.
  - Backups: encrypted snapshots retained for 90 days.

I'll attach a MAP with milestones and owners (draft). Proposed next step: 30-min call Thursday to walk the MAP and DPA redline approach.

Sofia Ivanova
Director, Solutions 
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Sentinel_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft, 24KB)

Natalie — appreciate the checklist. A few commercial/ops notes to set expectations: 

1) Evidence delivery
   - SOC 2 (FY2026 Type II) — attached PDF. We will produce the AICPA bridge letter and the pen-test summary on request.
   - CAIQ — we'll return a completed CAIQ workbook + notes (8 business days as Sofia noted).

2) DPA / legal process
   - Please send the Sentinel-marked DPA to ben_carter@redwoodinference.com and legal@redwoodinference.com. We aim to respond to redlines within 5 business days for standard requests. Complex carveouts (data residency or on-prem hosting) may need 2–3 weeks.
   - Subprocessor list: current list attached; we'll include expected update cadence in the MAP.

3) Data retention windows — commercial summary (draft):
   - Default user content retention: 90 days post-termination (negotiable to 1 year under enterprise add-on).
   - Audit logs: 365 days.
   - Backups/snapshots: 90 days; emergency restores available per request subject to SLAs.

4) Acceptance gate criteria (MAP milestones)
   - Milestone 1: Receipt of CAIQ answers (owner: Kimberly) — target: 2026-12-10
   - Milestone 2: DPA initial redline response (owner: Ben) — target: 2026-12-08 from receipt of markups
   - Milestone 3: SOC 2 distribution & QnA (owner: Sofia) — target: 2026-12-03
   - Milestone 4: Final signoff / enablement date — target: 2026-12-20 (subject to legal cadence)

Let us know if we should accelerate any milestone; we can prioritize DPA review if your procurement needs a faster close.

Ben Carter

Hi Natalie — quick technical notes on the CAIQ and retention mechanics so Aaron has what he needs: 

- CAIQ: we'll mark 'Yes/No/Partially' per question and include commentary for any "Partial" answers with evidence links (internal runbooks or controls screenshots). Where possible we'll point to SOC 2 control IDs for traceability.

- Data classification & retention details (proposed):
  - PII / account identifiers: retained 5 years only if required by contract or legal hold; otherwise deleted 90 days after termination.
  - Conversation content (LLM inputs/outputs): retained for 90 days by default; customers can request immediate purge via the admin console or a formal support ticket.
  - Debug logs / KV cache: redact sensitive fields and store for 30 days; full forensic logs (with IDS info) available for 365 days under enterprise agreement.
  - Exports & eDiscovery: We support exported datasets via S3 link with 7-day expiry; we will sign an access attestation when delivering exports.

- Evidence artifacts we'll attach to the CAIQ: SOC 2 control mappings, penetration-test high-level summary, KMS key rotation policy snippet, and our logging retention policy.

I'll aim to have the CAIQ draft to you by 2026-12-10 as Sofia and Ben suggested. If you have specific control IDs you want called out, paste them here and we'll prioritize.

Best —
Kimberly Park
Senior Product Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

2) For the DPA: we're going to send a redline with a requested change to the retention period for backups (from 90 days to 2 years) and a clause about notification for subprocessor additions. Can you confirm whether that retention change would be an enterprise-only term or something you can accept broadly?
3) Aaron will run the CAIQ review; he flagged the need for a KV cache diagram that shows eviction policies. Can Kimberly include that in the CAIQ attachments?

We'll send the DPA redline by end of business today. If you can commit to the CAIQ by 12/10 and DPA initial response within 5 business days of our redline, we can target final signoff by 12/20. Please confirm and we'll calendar the 30-min call for Thursday 12/4 10:00 AM PST.
